## PDF Signature 1.0.1: sign PDFs and fill in PDF forms on Windows, free and offline

### ⬇️ Downloads
| File | Description |
|---|---|
| **PDF-Signature-Setup-1.0.1.exe** | Installer (recommended). Adds Start-menu and desktop shortcuts and "Open with" for PDF files. |
| **PDF-Signature-1.0.1-win-x64-portable.zip** | Portable, no install. Unzip anywhere and run `PDF Signature.exe`. |

Requires Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit). The app isn't code-signed yet: if SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC", click **More info → Run anyway**.

### ✨ What's new in 1.0.1
- **Fillable PDF forms:** fill in text fields, multi-line fields, checkboxes, radio buttons and dropdowns right on the page. They stay editable form fields in the saved PDF.
- **Signature fields:** "Sign here" boxes are detected automatically. Click one, or drop a saved signature onto it, and the signature is fitted into the box.
- Restricted or password-protected forms keep their filled-in values in the flattened copy.

### Everything else
- Draw (mouse, touch, stylus with pen pressure), type (8 handwriting fonts) or upload a signature (automatic background removal)
- Saved signatures and initials, drag & drop onto any page
- Text, dates, checkmarks, crosses, dots and images; color, opacity, duplicate, undo/redo
- Exact placement on rotated and cropped pages, page thumbnails, zoom, dark mode, keyboard shortcuts
- 100% offline: no account, no upload, no tracking

Full details are in the [README](https://github.com/asadal12/pdf-signature#readme) and the [changelog](https://github.com/asadal12/pdf-signature/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
